author: Forbes
description:
How did a Swiss startup with zero footwear manufacturing experience take on giants like Nike and Adidas—and succeed?

What began in 2010 with pieces of garden hose glued to a running shoe has grown into On, a $12 billion Swiss sportswear company challenging the biggest names in athletic footwear.

Forbes sits down with On cofounders Caspar Coppetti and David Allemann at the brand's New York City flagship store to uncover the risks, early setbacks, and groundbreaking innovations that transformed a radical idea into a global sneaker phenomenon—with a little help from tennis legend Roger Federer.
